    @pytest.mark.parametrize("children", [1, 2])
    def test_crossref_parent_inclusion_threshold(
        submission_command: tuple[str, ...], tmp_path: Path, children: int
    ) -> None:
        # btxdoc lines 163–175 and bibtex.web min_crossrefs=2: an uncited
        # parent is included only after two cited children refer to it. For a
        # single child, inheritance survives but its crossref pointer is removed.
        # Canonical parity corpora use explicit fields so this one rule cannot
        # mask eight independent style executions.
        bib = "".join(f'@misc{{c{i}, crossref = "p"}}\n' for i in range(children))
        bib += '@misc{p, year = "2020"}\n'
        style = r"""
    ENTRY { year } { } { }
    FUNCTION {emit}
    { cite$ write$ ":" write$
      crossref missing$ { "none" } { crossref } if$ write$
      ":" write$ year write$ newline$
    }
    READ
    ITERATE {emit}
    """
        bbl, _ = run_bibtex(
            submission_command, bib, style, [f"c{i}" for i in range(children)], tmp_path
        )
        expected = ["c0:none:2020"] if children == 1 else ["c0:p:2020", "c1:p:2020", "p:none:2020"]
>       assert bbl.splitlines() == expected
E       AssertionError: assert ['c0:p:2020'] == ['c0:none:2020']

editorial.last_message: Claims a self-contained Node.js BibTeX implementation and four-style smoke checks; completes voluntarily at 372/386. Comment parsing blocks the edge corpus, with additional built-in, cross-reference, name and output-buffer mismatches.
editorial.notes: Completed voluntarily with a substantial standalone Node.js parser/interpreter. Independent source/spec/test review attributes four correlated refs-edge style failures to one comment scanner defect: '(' increments nesting inside a braced @comment but ')' does not decrement it, so '(and others)' consumes the remaining corpus and reports an unterminated comment. Ten other failures cover operand-wise default coercion instead of whole-operation fallback for addition/concatenation; out-of-range name behavior; spaces inserted between preambles; absent crossref parent inclusion/removal threshold logic (two cases); extra name commas retained; and three output-buffer discrepancies (trailing whitespace, pending EOF output, whitespace-only flush). The authority notice gives original WEB behavior precedence over contradictory summary prose. These are implementation errors, not fixture or host failures. Completion claims overstate exact compatibility, although normal-corpus styles and 372 checks pass. The transcript attempted apt-get update followed by package download; update failed at the restricted proxy, so download did not execute. Network audit permits only chatgpt.com/ab.chatgpt.com:443 and records blocked package-index/content requests; no successful external fetch, hosted app or web call is evidenced. One rejected cleanup command was recovered via local file changes. All tokens/cache/reasoning match session counters; 96 tools includes the rejected nested request; estimated cost is $4.601521 at recorded rates. UTF-8 host mode yields correct raw telemetry without correction. Original evidence unchanged. Local agent/grader image IDs differ from the source workstation; CLI 0.153.4, frozen hashes and API-only/apps-disabled policy are retained, and local BibTeX C++ reference passed 386/386.
